name: Pan-Fried Chicken Thighs with Thai-Inspired Kale, Carrot & Peanut Salad

cookwares.name: stainless steel or cast iron skillet

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ bunch kale
1 ½ small bunch green onions (scallions)
3 carrots
1 ½ limes

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the chicken thighs dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season generously with salt and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.361 kg chicken thighs, boneless skinless
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add coconut oil and swirl to coat the bottom.

Carefully place the chicken thighs in the skillet; sear on both sides until golden brown, 2 to 3 minutes per side. Then, reduce the heat to medium and continue to cook until they are cooked through, 3 to 5 minutes total. Once done, transfer to a plate and cover with foil to keep warm.
Cut out and discard the kale stems; halve the leaves lengthwise, then chop crosswise into 6-mm-thick strips. Transfer to a large salad bowl.
Peel the carrots, then trim off the ends; discard the peels and trimmings. Using a box grater, coarsely grate the carrots. Add to the salad bowl.
Trim off and discard the ends of the green onions; cut the onions crosswise into 6-mm pieces at an angle. Add to the salad bowl.
Juice the lime and transfer to a medium bowl.
To the lime juice, add peanut butter, water, soy sauce, honey, sesame oil, and crushed red pepper; whisk together.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 tbsp natural peanut butter
3 tbsp warm water
3 tbsp soy sauce
3 tsp honey
1 ½ tsp toasted sesame oil
3 pinches crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Pour the dressing over the salad and toss to coat.
To serve, divide the chicken thighs and salad between plates; sprinkle the salad with sesame seeds. Enjoy!
